engine._comment: WssdApi owns state-store selection (plugin redis_url / SAPO_REDIS_URL env) and log level (plugin log_level). Do NOT add engine.state_redis, engine.state_dir or engine.log_level here: the engine would take over store selection from state_redis/state_dir (and fail startup when unresolvable), and override the plugin log level.

secrets._comment: Referenced from blueprints as secret.<name> (e.g. ${secret.paystack_secret_key}). Expected keys for the sample payment plugins: hubtel_client_id, hubtel_client_secret, paystack_secret_key, magma_pay_token, magma_pay_user_secret. Keys intentionally NOT defined here: an empty committed value would shadow the engine's SAPO_SECRET_<NAME> environment fallback (e.g. SAPO_SECRET_PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY), which is how production injects secrets.

payments._comment: Provider endpoints and public merchant config for the sample checkout plugins in sapo/plugins/. Referenced as ${config.payments.<provider>.<key>}.
